title: Proper bounded constructible pushforward for certified adic coefficients
statement: For a certified ell-adic coefficient ring Λ and a proper morphism g, the bounded constructible derived pushforward is a left adjoint.

proof.text: Eliminate the coefficient certificate. Each constructor is exactly one of the three upstream proper-pushforward instances for continuous, integral, or algebraic-closure coefficients. Apply the corresponding instance in each branch.

mathlib_searches.query: proper bounded constructible pushforward left adjoint coefficient certificate

mathlib_searches.results: Generic adjunction API only; coefficient cases are upstream declarations.

from.place: the three named coefficient cases in the right-adjoint hypothesis

lean.statement:
theorem ellAdic_isLeftAdjoint_boundedConstructibleLowerStar [IsProper g.left]
    [IsFinitenessCoefficient ℓ Λ]
    (hΛ : IsEllAdicCoefficient ℓ Λ inferInstance) :
    (boundedConstructibleLowerStar Λ ℓ g).IsLeftAdjoint
